statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and episodes of syncope
There is clinical concern for underlying arrhythmia
Evaluation suggests paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I47.1) as a potential etiology
Evaluation suggests supraventricular tachycardia (I48.0) as a potential etiology
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
CPT 93271 is medically necessary to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes
